embeds.title: ARTICLE XIII — ANNUAL DRAFT
embeds.description:
The annual BLHA draft is **5 rounds** and **linear**, not snake. It is expected to begin approximately **2–3 weeks after the NHL Entry Draft**.

The draft uses an **8-hour pick clock** with a **12:00 AM–8:00 AM ET** pause. Managers are encouraged to maintain queues. Timeout handling may use Fantrax queue/autodraft or temporary-skip tools as announced before the draft.

The player pool is **not restricted to the current NHL draft class**. Any unowned player in the Fantrax player pool who satisfies BLHA minor-league eligibility may be selected.
